---
name: my-skill
description: Use this skill whenever you build, edit or review any page, calculator or quiz for the First Rupee website.
---

1. Brand: the name is "First Rupee", always two capitalised words, never shortened. The tagline "Your first steps to growing your money." appears under the logo.
2. Voice: a calm, patient finance teacher speaking to a Pakistani student aged 19–24. Address the reader as "you", keep sentences under 20 words, define each technical term on first use, and give Urdu terms their English meaning once, as in "munafa (profit)". No hype, fear or urgency.
3. Colours: define these as CSS variables and use no others: --teal #1F5F5B (primary), --teal-dark #164744 (hover), --cream #FAF7F0 (background), --ink #1E2A2A (text), --muted #5C6B6A, --sage #DCE8E2 (cards), --saffron #E0A43A (highlights), --risk #B84A3E (warnings only).
4. Type and layout: Source Serif 4 for headings, Inter for body text with tabular figures for numbers. Spacing in 8 px steps, cards with a 12 px radius and one soft shadow, text no wider than 70 characters.
5. Every page has: a header with the logo and navigation (Home → index.html, Ways to Invest → index.html#ways, Calculator → tools.html#calculator, Risk Quiz → tools.html#quiz), one H1, a "Last updated" date, and a footer that says "Educational content, not financial advice".
6. Investment options (savings accounts, National Savings schemes, mutual funds, PSX stocks, gold, real estate) appear as cards on the home page, each with: What it is, How to start, Risk (1–5), Liquidity, Who it suits.
7. Money: write "Rs 5,000": "Rs", a space, comma separators, no decimals. Ranges as "Rs 1,000–5,000".
8. Percentages: exactly one decimal place ("7.5%"). Label every example return "illustrative". Never state current published rates or real market figures.
9. Dates: "23 November 2026", never all-numeric. Write time periods in words, such as "5 years".
10. Calculator: inputs are starting amount, monthly deposit, illustrative annual rate, years and inflation rate. Compound monthly. Show nominal and inflation-adjusted totals, total deposited, growth, and a year-by-year table. State the formula and assumptions below the results.
11. Risk quiz: 8 questions scored 1–4. Bands: Careful (8–15), Balanced (16–24), Growth-minded (25–32). Each band explains matching asset categories, never products. Answers are never stored or sent anywhere.
12. Never name a specific stock, fund, bank, scheme provider or property, and never promise or imply returns.
